name: rfid-opentag
title: OpenTag3D Filament Tag
author: bespoked
description: Reads OpenTag3D (queengooborg open standard) filament NFC tags: the big-endian binary payload carried in an NDEF application/opentag3d record (manufacturer, material, color, diameter, weight, nozzle and bed temperatures) is decoded into the shared rfid_data.json. Plaintext, no key needed. Requires the RFID Spool Reader, which it installs automatically. Read-only: it never writes a tag. Experiment channel until verified on a real tag.
tagline: Read OpenTag3D open-standard filament tags on stock firmware.
attributions:
# Attributions - rfid-opentag
